rubric.criterion: Tells customers about both breaking changes: the old /v1/orders endpoint is removed and API keys created before 2025 expire, and gives the date 2026-12-01.
Says what to do: switch to /v2/orders, and re-issue old API keys in Settings, then API, before that date.
Mentions the improvements customers will notice: the CSV time zone column, invoice PDFs with long company names, dark mode, and the duplicate-email fix.
Leaves out internal work: the build tooling update, the billing refactor and the README change.
Is written in plain language for non-technical readers, with no commit labels such as feat, fix or chore.
